items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: he had called me up and said he was doing a demo session, but he couldn’t pay me. So he said you can bring down a tune, and we’ll record it and you can keep the demo.

ctx.x: How did you get with GRP? Did someone just happen to see you? Or just connections?

Well I went to school with Noel Pointer and he had called me up and said he was doing a demo session, but he couldn’t pay me. So he said you can bring down a tune, and we’ll record it and you can keep the demo. I said all right, fine. So I brought down a tune called “Rain Storm.” And after I finished the tune this guy comes out of the engineer’s booth and he goes, “You know I really like that tune, do you have any more?” So I said, “Yeah I’ve got tons of stuff.” So eventually I found out that that man was Larry…
